seo.titel: Intake Form – Preparing for your session | Tarra Lanzilli
seo.beschrijving: Complete the confidential intake form in peace to prepare for your ceremony or breathwork session with Nathalie at Tarra Lanzilli in Sappemeer.

hero.label: Preparation & Safety
hero.kop: Intake form – Preparing for your session
hero.tekst: A ceremony or breathwork session begins with careful preparation. Through these questions I get to know you, your background, and your health, allowing me to create a safe and lovingly attuned space for you.

formulier.verplichtNotitie: Only your name, phone number, email address, and the consent checkbox at the bottom are required. For the remaining questions, share what feels right for you.
formulier.foutMelding: Please check the highlighted required fields (name, phone number, email address, and the consent checkbox at the bottom).

persoonlijk.intro: How may I address you and how can I reach you to coordinate our appointment?

facebook.label: Facebook (optional)
facebook.placeholder: Your name or profile link on Facebook

levensloop.intro: Patterns and beliefs often have their roots in our earliest years. Share per life phase what you know or what feels relevant to you.

conceptie.label: From conception
conceptie.toelichting: How did your mother's pregnancy go? Were you planned/wanted, was there stress, grief, or special circumstances?
conceptie.placeholder: What you know or sense about this...

geboorte.label: Birth
geboorte.toelichting: How did your birth go (e.g. natural, C-section, premature, incubator) and how were the first weeks?
geboorte.placeholder: Course of your birth and first weeks...

kindertijd.label: Age 0–7 years
kindertijd.toelichting: How did you experience your early childhood and the family you grew up in? Did it feel safe and secure?
kindertijd.placeholder: Memories or impressions from your early childhood...

tienerjaren.label: Teenage years
tienerjaren.toelichting: How did your adolescence, school years, and contact with peers or family go?
tienerjaren.placeholder: Important experiences from your teenage years...

volwassen.label: Adult life (20+ to present)
volwassen.toelichting: Which important events, relationships, losses, or turning points have shaped your adult life?
volwassen.placeholder: A broad outline of your path so far...

traumaOuders.label: Parental trauma
traumaOuders.toelichting: Are there major life events or unresolved themes in your parents' lives or family line that still resonate?
traumaOuders.placeholder: What you know about your parents' background...

gezondheid.intro: For a safe ceremony or breathwork session, it is essential to have a clear picture of any medical conditions and contraindications.

ziekenhuis.label: Hospital admissions / surgeries
ziekenhuis.placeholder: Have you ever been hospitalized or operated on? If so, for what and when?

hartproblemen.label: Heart conditions or other physical conditions
hartproblemen.toelichting: Think of cardiovascular disease, high or low blood pressure, epilepsy, asthma, glaucoma, or a possible pregnancy.
hartproblemen.placeholder: Describe any physical conditions or complaints...

verslaving.label: Addiction or sensitivity to addiction
verslaving.placeholder: Is there or has there been any addiction or sensitivity to addiction?

medicatie.label: Medication use
medicatie.toelichting: Please list all medications you take (especially antidepressants such as SSRIs/MAOIs, ADHD medication, sleeping pills/tranquilizers, and blood pressure medication).
medicatie.placeholder: Which medications or supplements do you currently use?

aandoeningen.label: Physical or mental health conditions (including family history)
aandoeningen.toelichting: E.g. depression, burnout, PTSD, personality disorders, bipolar disorder, or sensitivity to psychosis (including in your family).
aandoeningen.placeholder: Any diagnoses or sensitivities in yourself or your family...

huidigeBehandeling.label: Currently in treatment with a therapist or doctor
huidigeBehandeling.placeholder: Are you currently receiving treatment or care? If so, with whom and for what?

eerdereBehandeling.label: Previous treatment for psychological complaints
eerdereBehandeling.placeholder: Have you received therapy, coaching, or mental health support in the past?

huidig.intro: What does your life look like right now and what brings you to this session?

woonsituatie.label: Living situation
woonsituatie.placeholder: How do you live (alone, with partner, family) and how do you experience your current home environment?

emoties.label: Daily emotions
emoties.placeholder: Which feelings or moods are prominent in your daily life?

probleem.label: Own description of issue / theme
probleem.placeholder: What are you struggling with or which pattern is on your mind?

oorzaak.label: Cause, trigger, or circumstances
oorzaak.placeholder: What do you feel is the cause or what triggers this?

verwachtingen.label: Expectations for the session
verwachtingen.placeholder: What is your longing or intention? What do you hope the session will bring you?

ervaring.intro: Finally, a few brief questions about your experience with substances, plant medicines, and somatic work.

drugs.label: Substance use
drugs.toelichting: Do you use alcohol, cannabis, tobacco, or recreational substances (and how often)?

entheogenen.label: Use of entheogenic substances
entheogenen.toelichting: Have you previously journeyed with truffles, mushrooms, ayahuasca, or other plant medicines? How did you experience that?

lichaamswerk.label: Previous experience with bodywork / breathwork
lichaamswerk.toelichting: For example connected breathwork, BRTT, TRB, yoga, meditation, or somatic therapy.
lichaamswerk.placeholder: Your experience with breathwork or bodywork...

aanvullend.intro: Let me know below which form of session you prefer and when you would like to come.

ceremonieVoorkeur.label: Which session do you prefer?
opties: Decide together during an introductory call

datum.label: Preferred date or period for the session
datum.placeholder: E.g. preferred days, a specific month, or 'in consultation'

bijzonderheden.label: Other remarks or details
bijzonderheden.placeholder: Is there anything else important to know (e.g. dietary needs, allergies, or questions)?

ondertekening.toelichting: Draw your signature below with your mouse or finger (or type your name) to confirm your intake.
ondertekening.akkoordTekst: I declare that I have completed this form truthfully and consent to the confidential processing of my (health) data in preparation for my session, as described in the

succes.tekst: Your intake form has been completed. Here is how we will proceed from here:

stappen.tekst: I will review your answers calmly and in complete confidence.
Within a few days I will contact you by phone or WhatsApp to get acquainted and discuss your intake together.
When it feels right and safe for both of us, we will set a date and you will receive all practical preparation guidelines.
